summary: Validated curated 12-voice ElevenLabs DJ picker + voice_style presets (energetic/smooth/announcer) across backend API, station persistence, station creator UI, edit flow, and live player DJ break. All backend and frontend assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1156 lines and should ideally be modularized (routers/services), but not blocking.
Bumper response embeds full base64 mp3 (~tens of KB) inline — fine for demo, but a streaming endpoint or signed URL would scale better.

voice_style is validated only by VOICE_STYLE_PRESETS.get(..., default) — invalid styles silently fall back to energetic. Consider Pydantic Literal['energetic','smooth','announcer'] to reject typos at API boundary.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_UI_Station (UI) and TEST_voice_style_station (pytest). Both removed at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_yourfm_voices.py covers: GET /api/elevenlabs/voices (exactly 12 curated voices across 4 vibes Top 40/Chill Lofi/Rock / Metal/Accents); POST /api/bumpers/generate parametrized over energetic/smooth/announcer + default; Station CRUD persisting voice_style. Frontend Playwright validates: optgroup labels, 12 voices, voice-style-select options, description appears on voice select, station card appears after create, edit-station pre-populates voice + voice_style + name, play+4 skips triggers bumper banner, captured POST body confirms voice_id and voice_style match station.
verified_flows: GET /api/elevenlabs/voices returns exactly 12 curated voices, all vibes in {Top 40, Chill Lofi, Rock / Metal, Accents}, IDs match spec (Liam, Adam, Will, George + 8 more).
POST /api/bumpers/generate with voice_id Adam (pNInz6obpgDQGcFmaJgB) returns 200 + audio_url for voice_style=energetic, smooth, announcer, and when omitted (defaults to energetic).
Station create/get/update with voice_style persists correctly in Mongo.
UI: voice-select renders <optgroup> by vibe with 12 voices; voice-style-select has 3 expected options; description text appears after voice selection.
Create flow end-to-end: start-listening -> nav-create -> form -> name + feedfm-station + Rock/Metal voice (Callum) + smooth style + topic -> returns to My Stations with new card.
Play + 4 skips fires DJ break, bumper-banner appears, POST /api/bumpers/generate body contains voice_id=N2lVS1w4EtoT3dr4eOWO and voice_style=smooth. No console errors.
No 'No custom voices found' message anywhere; picker is never empty.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All curated voice IDs (including Liam, Adam, Will, George, Callum tested) accepted by ElevenLabs key with eleven_multilingual_v2 model.
